title: Custom Tables (customer-defined tables, fields and rows)
summary: An administrator defines a table (key, name), its fields and rows in Dev Center, through the Dynamic Data Table API, or by CSV import. Intended for reference data, mappings, lookup lists, flags and light extensions, not core business data. Reading the data from a storefront or a calculation needs a custom endpoint or a Webstore change.
when_to_use: map ERP or legacy ids to Znode ids
small lookup or configuration lists used by custom code
light extensions to display or logic where an attribute or user-defined field does not fit
not_for: an extra field on a product, account, user or store (use PIM attributes or Global Attributes)
large, fast-changing or transactional data, or data needing joins or foreign keys
direct SQL access to the table's database (the KB says the Custom API has none)

contract.api: Dynamic Data Table API, 30 operations under /v1/custom-tables, /v1/custom-table-fields, /v1/custom-table-data (spec: nd-knowledge/specs/custom-table.json)
contract.field_types: Text, TextArea, Number (cannot currently be created), Numeric, Boolean, datetime (lowercase)
contract.settings: System Settings > Global Settings > Custom Table Settings: CustomTableMaxFieldLengthForText, ...ForTextArea, ...ForNumber (blank = no ceiling)
contract.sdk: ICustomTableClient registered in CustomDependencyRegistration; sample call GetCustomTables(null, null, 1, 10) in CustomService

evidence.note: Admin paths, field settings, records, import and export
positioning, advisory limits, recommended and discouraged uses

docs.title: Custom Tables - Limitations & Fair Usage Guidelines

limitations: No joins, foreign keys or composite keys; one unique field per table, only on Text or Number, not addable once rows exist
The Number (integer) field type cannot be created; use Numeric with scale 0
The API has no per-role or ownership checks: wrap it in an endpoint that authorizes
Imports report success on partial failure; read the import log
Bulk, import and delete-by-value paths raise no events; single-row routes do
The published spec's import contract (importData, importType) is not what the implementation uses
known_issues: KB's Text 4,000 / Text Area 8,000 are the largest values the Global Settings form accepts, not fixed validation limits; blank settings mean no check
Some GET responses are double-encoded JSON
Behaviours observed before 10.14.0.0 may have changed with its stricter request validation
platform_change_if: a new system table or a change to what a system table does
joins, foreign keys or transactions across tables
direct database access to custom table data
